Supplier FAQs & Guidelines
Standard operating procedures and policy rules

Invoices can only be created against purchase orders after the goods or services have been received and inspected via an approved Goods Receipt Note (GRN). You cannot invoice quantities exceeding the accepted GRN count.

ProcureSphere 360 automatically reconciles your invoice line prices and quantities against the Purchase Order and GRN. Variances within configured tolerances (e.g. ±5%) pass automatically; larger discrepancies trigger an exception for buyer review.

Per corporate compliance and anti-fraud standards, only PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLSX, and CSV documents are accepted. Image formats (PNG, JPG, JPEG) are prohibited to ensure verifiable document integrity.

Once an invoice achieves "Ready For Payment" status post-match approval, disbursement is processed via NEFT / RTGS / ACH within the net payment terms agreed in your contract (typically 30 to 45 calendar days).
